description: Query Netlify projects, deploys, teams, and forms, deploy sites, and inspect deployment details. Create projects, update project settings and environment variables, work with form submissions, and manage extension installations for site publishing and maintenance.
description_cn: 查询 Netlify 项目、部署、团队和表单，部署站点并查看部署详情。支持创建项目、修改项目设置和环境变量、处理表单提交及管理扩展安装，辅助站点发布与维护。
